title: 00167 - P068A/001674
engines: Tüm VAG Benzinli (TSI/TFSI) ve Dizel (TDI) Motorlar
commonCauses: Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Power Supply Relay (J271/J317) faulty
stepByStepSolution: Kontrol edin:  Sigorta ve Röle Bağlantıları(s)
Kontrol edin:  Kablo Tesisatı ve Soketleri and/or Connector(s) from/to Power Supply Relay (J271/J317)
Kontrol edin: /Değiştirin / Yenileyin:  Power Supply Relay (J271/J317)
technicalNotes:
A weak Battery may set this fault code. Insure the Battery voltage is at least 11.5v.
2009-2014 Audi vehicles with no start issues, please see TSB 97-14-2 or TPI 2036764 for possible updated J271 relay.
https://static.nhtsa.gov/odi/tsbs/2014/SB-10055713-5611.pdf  NHTSA
